name: Nephrology
boundaries: Nephrology: fundamental discoveries and enabling technologies within this field. Include cross-field consequences where the central advance belongs to this field; exclude routine incremental optimization. Use the historical breakthroughs in the prompt to calibrate revolutionary impact.

original_dispositions.reason: The historical claims of ending all dialysis and reversing every stage of chronic kidney disease are not established consequences.
Covered by NEP-04 and NEP-05; tissue-engineered human organs also overlap NEP-03. Complete endocrine replacement, no external power and elimination of all complications are not assumed.

original_dispositions.original_title: Molecular cure for diabetic kidney disease
original_dispositions.reason: The completion test requires kidney repair beyond glucose control; “any stage” remains unproven.
Tolerance would not eliminate every infection, malignancy or graft-loss risk.

original_dispositions.original_title: Early biomarker panel predicting kidney failure with over 95% accuracy
original_dispositions.reason: Prediction alone does not establish a comparably transformative treatment or principle, and “accuracy” is undefined without a population, outcome, time horizon and performance measure. Existing risk equations already predict progression: Tangri et al. reported a five-year C statistic of 0.88 and noted calibration limitations. A C statistic is not the percentage of individual predictions that are correct.
Functional recovery, not scar removal alone, is the proposed achievement.
Prevention, arrest of progression and reversal of established structural damage are distinguished.
Broad prevention of severe injury across major settings would be revolutionary; total prevention in every context is neither demonstrated nor required.

original_dispositions.original_title: A primary renal driver of most essential hypertension plus a cure
original_dispositions.reason: This asserts a single predominant cause without establishing that such a cause exists. A demonstrated renal mechanism explaining and curably treating a major share of cases could qualify, but the historical entry does not specify evidence for that unifying premise.
Bioprinting is one potential manufacturing method; patient-specific compatibility, production in weeks and freedom from immunosuppression remain separate unproven claims.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Retained NEP-01 through NEP-07 and their identities.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Clarified limits on disease reversal, immune compatibility, accessibility and downstream benefits.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Updated NEP-07 with the 2025 randomized tolerance trial.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Its matched-sibling population and conditioning requirements constrain generalization.
Root-cause ADPKD treatment is distinct from generic scar reversal and has specific preclinical gene-editing evidence.

Diabetic kidney disease reversal is a distinct, high-impact disease-specific target; historical lesion-reversal evidence and modern outcome trials support its plausibility while falling short of the proposed capability.
Broad prevention of severe acute kidney injury is distinct from chronic disease repair. The proposed outcome is narrower and more testable than the historical claim of universal prevention.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Corrected the fibrosis review’s publication date.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: It was published online in August 2026 and appeared in the September issue.
